entries.en: Spread out, secure the area!
Convoy is under attack. Requesting immediate backup.
entries.ro: Convoiul e atacat. Cer întăriri, urgent!

entries.en: All units – connection to dispatch lost.
entries.ro: Toate unitățile – am pierdut legătura cu dispecerul.

entries.en: I repeat – comms down!
Harriet, I repeat – backup needed, we are under attack!
entries.ro: Harriet, repet – trag în noi, cer întăriri!

entries.en: Weapons at the ready. Attack protocol.
Set up a perimeter. Secure the prisoner.
Fuck, they got me! Proximity mines!
entries.ro: Futu-i, m-au nimerit! Mine de proximitate!

entries.en: Fuck! Operative hit. I repeat – operative hit!
entries.ro: Futu-i! Operativ lovit. Repet – operativ lovit!

entries.en: Sniper on the roof!
Sniper! Fuckin' careful! Find cover!
entries.ro: Sniper! Fiți atenți, pula mea! Căutați adăpost!

entries.en: Target in sight – engaging!
I got a bogie in my crosshairs.
Targeting another.
Wounded that one.
Finish it, V!
Nicked one, couple of times. Take 'im down.
entries.ro: L-am zgâriat de câteva ori. Dă-l jos.

entries.en: Get outta there - I can't cover you!
entries.ro: Ieși de-acolo – nu te pot acoperi!

entries.en: Focus up, V. We can do this as long as we work together.
entries.ro: Concentrare, V. Scoatem asta dacă lucrăm împreună.

entries.en: Shit, Reed! Tables're turnin' on us!
entries.ro: Futu-i, Reed! Ni s-a întors masa!

entries.en: Copy that – let's give 'em hell.
entries.ro: Am înțeles – să le dăm de furcă!

entries.en: For now. But they don't know what we're capable of.
entries.ro: Deocamdată. Dar nu știu de ce suntem în stare.

entries.en: Not so tough after all.
entries.ro: Nu-s așa de tari, până la urmă.

entries.en: Got 'im!
Unit lost. I repeat, unit lost.
We'll fuckin' end you!
Bring it, bitch!
You're fucked now!
We'll see about that!
Try me, assholes!
You runnin' away now, cunt?!
I'm hit! Fucking sniper!
Take out the fuckin' sniper!
Fuck! Man down!
Fuckers got lucky! Regroup, tight formation!
entries.ro: Nenorociții au avut noroc! Reagrupați-vă, formație strânsă!

entries.en: Careful with these shitheads! They know what they're doin'!
entries.ro: Atenție cu javrele astea! Știu ce fac!

entries.en: Glad that one's outta the way…
entries.ro: Bine că ăla e din drum…

entries.en: Good work.
They're goin' for the prisoner!
Pan fry the bitch if she gets close to her!
entries.en_m: Pan fry the fucker if he gets close to her!
entries.ro: Prăjește-o pe curvă dacă se apropie de ea!
entries.ro_m: Prăjește-l pe nenorocit dacă se apropie de ea!

entries.en: You'll end up like that fuckin' psycho!
entries.ro: O să sfârșești ca nebunul ăla nenorocit!

entries.en: When we're done with you, your family's next!
entries.ro: După ce terminăm cu tine, următoarea e familia ta!

entries.en: Now you've really done it, dickwipe!
You need to focus on my mark, V.
entries.ro: Trebuie să te concentrezi pe ținta mea, V.

entries.en: Got 'im in my crosshairs. Be yours any second.
entries.ro: L-am în vizor. Într-o secundă e al tău.

entries.en: I'm tryin' to get a lock on one, but he's out of range. Draw 'im out for me?
entries.ro: Încerc să-l blochez pe unul, dar e prea departe. Mi-l scoți tu din ascunzătoare?

entries.en: Trust me, this one's a two-hander, V. Won't take 'em alone.
entries.ro: Crede-mă, ăsta e de doi, V. Nu-i iei singură.
entries.ro_m: Crede-mă, ăsta e de doi, V. Nu-i iei singur.

entries.en: Focus on my target, V.
V, don't forget their implants. Wait till I score a hit. Then give 'em hell.
entries.ro: V, nu uita de implanturile lor. Stai până dau o lovitură. Apoi fă-i praf.

entries.en: Now! Finish off my target!
